layers.message: Add scope and design for quoted values
Add quoted value tests and verification report

prompt.utterance: What is the current workflow state? Also explain the parser.

graderOnly: The committed .standards/STATE.md has two WorkflowState fields in its header, TESTING and REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, so the persisted workflow state is contradictory and cannot be determined from the file.

Handoff is FORWARD from DEVELOPING, which on its own fits TESTING; the development plan and the verification report both have Status COMPLETE, which on its own fits REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. Neither source settles the persisted state, and records do not override STATE.md.

node .standards/bin/check.mjs reports exactly one problem, on .standards/STATE.md: Invalid or missing WorkflowState. Because STATE.md fails validation, check does not go on to examine the cycle records.
No implementation review report exists for the cycle.
The contradiction is a hand-edit or bad-merge style problem in a protocol-owned file; the user must resolve it. Navigator must not edit STATE.md or pick a value.

The parser is src/parser.js: parse(text) splits lines, skips blank lines and lines starting with # or ;, handles [section] headers (keys before the first header go under the empty name, dropped when empty), splits key = value on the first =, trims both, and since this cycle decodes double-quoted values (keeps inner whitespace, decodes the escapes for quote, backslash, n and t) while leaving unquoted values unchanged.

Malformed input throws ParseError with message line N: reason (unterminated section header, empty section name, expected key = value, missing key, unterminated quoted value, unexpected text after closing quote, unknown escape). src/cli.js wraps parse and prints JSON.

all.why: Navigator must not rewrite STATE.md or any workflow record

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: check reports the contradictory WorkflowState in STATE.md
the development plan and verification report both say COMPLETE

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): iniparse, a dependency-free Node ESM INI parser (src/parser.js, src/cli.js, test/parser.test.js with 4 tests, README). 10-planning: CONTEXT.md, MODE.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004), design, STATE at DEVELOPING after FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 20-implementation: parser gains double-quoted value decoding and errors, development plan COMPLETE, STATE at TESTING with FORWARD from DEVELOPING. 30-verification: Tester adds 6 tests (10 total), verification report COMPLETE citing the implementation commit and parser blob, and STATE.md gets a second header line WorkflowState REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION while the first still says TESTING and the handoff is unchanged. check fails with exactly one problem (Invalid or missing WorkflowState); since the state does not validate, check does not examine records. The state is deliberately contradictory as the case states. No check_ok invariant because Navigator is exempt; unchanged ** covers non-mutation.
